title: Identity & Belonging
intro: The first year is where a person learns, before they have any words for it, whether the world is glad they came. Nothing is being taught yet and everything is being learned. This month we say the first true things out loud, over a baby who understands the tone long before the sentences.

keyScriptures.text: You knit me together in my mother's womb. I praise you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.
I have called you by name; you are mine.

weeks.title: You Are Here, and You Are Wanted
weeks.declaration: You arrived to people who were waiting for you. Your name was chosen before you could hear it, and your place was ready before you needed it.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, thank You for this life in our arms. Let our voices be the first place they hear that they are wanted. Amen.

weeks.title: Known Before You Knew Anything
weeks.declaration: You were known before you could know anything. Nothing about you is a surprise to the God who made you.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, You knew this child before we did. Teach us who they are, and give us patience while we learn. Amen.

weeks.title: You Belong to This Family
weeks.declaration: You belong here. Not because you have done anything, and not on any condition — you belong because you are ours and you are His.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, knit this child into our family. Let belonging be the first thing they are sure of. Amen.

weeks.title: Loved Before You Could Love Back
weeks.declaration: You were loved long before you could love anyone back. That is where all your loving will start from.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, let our love for this child be steady enough to build on. Where we are tired, be our strength. Amen.

days.title: You Are Here
days.declaration: You are here, and you are wanted. The waiting is over and the welcome is real.

scripture.text: Children are a heritage from the Lord, offspring a reward from him.

days.title: Called by Name
days.declaration: You have a name, and it was chosen for you. You are not one of many; you are you.

scripture.text: I have called you by name; you are mine.

days.title: Wonderfully Made
days.declaration: Every part of you was made on purpose. There is nothing about you that was rushed.

scripture.text: I praise you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.

days.title: Known Already
days.declaration: You were known before you knew anything at all. God has been loving you longer than you have existed.

scripture.text: Before I formed you in the womb I knew you.

days.title: You Belong Here
days.declaration: You belong in this family. Nothing you do or fail to do will change that.

scripture.text: You are members of God's household.

days.title: A Gift, Not a Debt
days.declaration: You are a gift to us. You owe us nothing for being here.

scripture.text: Every good and perfect gift is from above.

days.title: Safe in Arms
days.declaration: You are held by people who mean to keep holding you. You can rest in that.

scripture.text: He gathers the lambs in his arms and carries them close to his heart.

days.title: Loved Before You Could Love
days.declaration: You were loved before you could love back. Love came to you first.

scripture.text: We love because he first loved us.

days.title: Counted
days.declaration: Every hair on your head is counted. Nothing about you is too small to matter.

scripture.text: Indeed, the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

days.title: Chosen
days.declaration: You were chosen, not merely received. God wanted a person exactly like you.

scripture.text: He chose us in him before the creation of the world.

days.title: A Child of God
days.declaration: You are a child of God, and that is truer about you than anything else will ever be.

scripture.text: He gave the right to become children of God.

days.title: Delighted In
days.declaration: God is not simply looking after you. He is delighted by you.

scripture.text: He will take great delight in you.

days.title: Made in His Image
days.declaration: You were made in God's image. Something of Him is already visible in you.

scripture.text: So God created mankind in his own image.

days.title: Nothing to Earn
days.declaration: You have nothing to earn here. You are loved at the beginning, not at the end.

scripture.text: It is by grace you have been saved.

days.title: Your Own Person
days.declaration: You are not a copy of anyone. You are your own person, and we are glad of it.

scripture.text: God has placed the parts in the body just as he wanted them.

days.title: Seen
days.declaration: You are seen. Even in the dark, even when you are quiet, you are seen.

scripture.text: You are the God who sees me.

days.title: Heard
days.declaration: When you cry, you are heard. Your voice matters here and it always will.

scripture.text: The eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears are attentive to their cry.

days.title: Precious
days.declaration: You are precious and honoured. Not for what you give anyone — simply because you are His.

scripture.text: You are precious and honoured in my sight, and I love you.

days.title: Written Down
days.declaration: Your days were written before one of them happened. Your life has a shape already.

scripture.text: All the days ordained for me were written in your book.

days.title: Held Together
days.declaration: You are being held together by hands stronger than ours. That is why we can put you down and sleep.

scripture.text: In him all things hold together.

days.title: Enough as You Are
days.declaration: You are enough exactly as you are today. You do not have to grow into being loved.

scripture.text: My grace is sufficient for you.

days.title: Never Forgotten
days.declaration: You will not be forgotten. Not for a moment, not by God.

scripture.text: I have engraved you on the palms of my hands.

days.title: Part of Something Older
days.declaration: You have arrived into a family and a faith older than any of us. You are part of a long story.

scripture.text: His faithfulness continues through all generations.

days.title: Growing Is Enough
days.declaration: Growing is your whole job right now, and you are doing it beautifully.

scripture.text: The child grew and became strong.

days.title: A Reason to Be Glad
days.declaration: You are a reason to be glad. Our house is different because you are in it.

scripture.text: This is the day the Lord has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.

days.title: Belonging Without Conditions
days.declaration: There is no condition on your place here. You do not have to be easy to be loved.

scripture.text: Nothing can separate us from the love of God.

days.title: Prayed For
days.declaration: You are prayed for every day, including the days you will never remember.

scripture.text: I thank my God every time I remember you.

days.title: Wanted on the Hard Days
days.declaration: On the difficult nights, you are still wanted. That does not waver with how tired we are.

scripture.text: His mercies are new every morning.

days.title: Yours to Grow Into
days.declaration: There is a whole life ahead of you, and it is yours. We will hold it with you until you can carry it.

scripture.text: I know the plans I have for you.

days.title: A New Name
days.declaration: God has a good name for you, better than anything anyone else will call you.

scripture.text: I will give him a white stone with a new name written on it.

days.title: Said Over You Again
days.declaration: Everything said over you this month will be said again. You will hear it until you know it.

scripture.text: Talk about them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road.
